note: Separate from the video/editor catalog (docs/reference/implementation_pack/question_catalog.json). Question ids are routing keys, not model context: every instruction names its target and evidence. Observed-content labels describe what is visible (including content inside an embedded image), never verified origin, geography, title or identity.
target: target_image: the whole still image identified by asset id, in display orientation (EXIF applied), representative frame 0 for animations

A.description: Capture/source/media-context heads sharing one image encode

capture_type.instructions: How was target_image produced? Use pixel measurements (flat regions, axis-aligned structure, camera EXIF presence) and the visual encoding. Camera EXIF alone does not prove a photo; missing EXIF does not prove a screenshot.

options.screenshot: A captured software/device screen: UI chrome, rendered text, flat synthetic regions dominate.
options.photo: A camera photograph of the physical world (including a photo of a screen).
options.scanned_document: A scan or photo-like capture of a paper page dominated by printed text.
options.graphic: A designed illustration, poster, meme, chart or logo that is not a screen capture.

source_app.instructions: Which app's visible user interface appears in target_image? Only visible supported UI evidence counts (layout plus UI text such as action bars). A brand name inside body text, a slide or a PDF is NOT evidence. This is visible UI, not a verified upload origin.

options.linkedin: LinkedIn web/mobile UI: post card with reactions/Comment/Repost/Send bar, or job card with Easy Apply/Apply.
options.youtube: YouTube player/watch page UI (subscribe button, views, video controls).
options.github: GitHub UI (repository header, Code/Issues/Pull requests tabs).
options.whatsapp: WhatsApp chat UI (chat bubbles with ticks, header with contact).
options.instagram: Instagram post/feed UI (like/comment/share icons, username header).
options.browser: A generic web browser window or page not matching a supported app.

context.film_tv_frame.instructions: Is target_image a frame from a film or TV production (cinematic framing, graded footage, possibly subtitles)? Black bars alone are not sufficient. Do not infer the title.
context.film_tv_frame.yes_criteria: Cinematic/broadcast footage frame is the main content.
context.film_tv_frame.no_criteria: A photo, UI, document, or graphic; letterboxing without cinematic content.

context.presentation_slide.instructions: Is target_image (or its main embedded content) a presentation slide?
context.presentation_slide.yes_criteria: Slide layout: title plus bullets/figure on a designed background.

context.source_code.instructions: Does target_image mainly show source code (editor, terminal, code block)?
context.source_code.yes_criteria: Program text with code syntax is the main content (OCR shows code tokens).
context.source_code.no_criteria: Prose, UI or photos without dominant code.

context.job_posting.instructions: Does target_image show a job posting or hiring announcement (role, company, apply)?
context.job_posting.yes_criteria: Visible text advertises a job/role or hiring call.

context.article.instructions: Does target_image mainly show an article or long-form text post?
context.article.yes_criteria: Multi-paragraph prose is the main content.
context.article.no_criteria: Short UI text, code, photos or slides.

context.conversation.instructions: Does target_image show a chat/messaging conversation?
context.conversation.yes_criteria: Message bubbles or alternating chat turns.

sufficiency.a.instructions: Was the evidence for Group A adequate (pixels decoded, OCR coverage complete or not needed, visual encoding available)?
sufficiency.a.yes_criteria: All Group A evidence stages complete.
sufficiency.a.no_criteria: A required stage is missing, partial or failed.

B.description: Scene and topic heads sharing one image encode

scene.beach.instructions: Does target_image visibly show a beach/seashore scene?
scene.beach.yes_criteria: Sand/shoreline with sea or lake water.

scene.city_street.instructions: Does target_image visibly show a city street scene?

scene.forest.instructions: Does target_image visibly show a forest/woodland?

scene.office.instructions: Does target_image visibly show an office interior?

scene.kitchen.instructions: Does target_image visibly show a kitchen?

scene.classroom.instructions: Does target_image visibly show a classroom?

scene.stadium.instructions: Does target_image visibly show a stadium/sports arena?

topic.hiring.instructions: Is the visible content about hiring, recruiting or job seeking?
topic.hiring.yes_criteria: OCR/visual content discusses jobs, roles, recruiting.

topic.ai_ml.instructions: Is the visible content about AI or machine learning?
topic.ai_ml.yes_criteria: Discusses AI/ML models, data science, LLMs, training.

topic.software_development.instructions: Is the visible content about software development?

topic.education.instructions: Is the visible content about education or learning?

topic.entertainment.instructions: Is the visible content about entertainment (film, TV, music, games)?

sufficiency.b.instructions: Was the evidence for Group B adequate (visual encoding available; OCR available for topic heads)?
